nodes.note: The walled yard in front of the watch-house, flagged with stone, the moor showing over its walls. The warden waits here beside the armoury door.

stations.note: Where Ide Fenwick stands, beside the armoury door, facing back across the yard toward where the party arrives.

nodes.note: One stone room with a plank floor. A rack of three armour stands along the west wall; a glow frame holding the moor map on the wall beside the door; a chest of arrows under the window in the north wall.

stations.note: The south stand of the rack, wearing the watch helmet.
The middle stand of the rack, holding the post sword.
The north stand of the rack, a shield on its off arm.
The glow frame on the door wall, east of the door, holding the moor map.
The chest under the window in the north wall, holding nothing but arrows.
